text:
maria.chen: Published the postmortem for the serving latency surge — https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/serving-latency-surge-1825 (RCA + timeline + diffs). TL;DR: a traffic spike + cache warmup issue exposed autoscaler and KV-cache cold-paths; most traffic recovered via regional fallback but we sustained elevated p95 for ~18m.

kevin.r: Thanks — quick q: do we have a short list of prioritised action items for the next 2 weeks?

maria.chen: Yes. top items in the doc under "Actionables (owner, ETA)". Quick copy: 1) KV cache warmup and fallback circuit (samir.k) — ETA 2026-04-02; 2) Autoscaler smoothing + burst cap (sophia.li) — ETA 2026-03-31; 3) Model routing rollback policy (maria.chen) — ETA 2026-04-05; 4) Customer comms draft (devex-ana) — ETA 2026-03-28.

sophia.li: I'll own the autoscaler work. Plan: add a 30s smoothing window, tune targetUtil to 65%, and add a graceful ramp policy for bursts. I'll post a PR with benchmarks.

samir.k: KV-cache patch is ready in my branch; needs runtime gating. Planning deploy to staging tomorrow morning, smoke test with long-context traces.

devex-ana: I'll start a customer-facing note for impacted tenants. Want to sync w/ legal on wording — can someone intro?

maria.chen: @devex-ana i'll loop in legal (cced in thread). Also linking the quick checklist for ops: ```- Promote KV patch behind feature flag
- Run cache warmup job for hot prefixes
- Enable regional fallback for older model variants
- Monitor p95 and error budget burn (alerting thresholds updated)```

kevin.r: Re: monitoring, did we update the tracing tags so we can correlate requests to autoscale events?

maria.chen: Good catch — tracing tags added in PR #4321, pushed to canary. Ops dashboard has a new panel: "autoscale-trigger -> request-origin".

ops-bot: Follow-up sync scheduled: 2026-03-30 17:00 UTC — Channel: #postmortems — Agenda: status updates on actionables, verification plan, customer comms. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/6b7f

incident-bot: RCA published by @maria.chen — link: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/serving-latency-surge-1825 — Severity: P2 — Duration: 00:18:43 — Tags: autoscale, kv-cache, regional-fallback

samir.k: Noted on the timeline. Will add smoke test results to the doc and tag owners.

maria.chen: Thanks everyone. Please update the document checklist as you complete items (use the checkboxes in the doc). If you can't meet ETA, ping me in-thread so we can re-prioritise. :thumbsup:

kevin.r: Acknowledged. I'll review the autoscaler PR once sophia posts it.

sophia.li: Will do — aiming for end-of-day PR and perf numbers by tomorrow.

devex-ana: I'll draft the customer note and post for review by 2026-03-28 EOD.

maria.chen: Closing note: main lessons — improve cache warmup on rollouts, add smoothing to autoscale, and formalise regional fallback playbooks. Doc includes follow-up checkpoints and a 30/60/90-day verification plan. Thanks all.
